subject: Request: short trial extension and token top-up due to integration delay
messages:
From: Alyssa Torres <alyssa@integral-labs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@integral-labs.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short trial extension & credits due to integration delay

Hi Jordan,

Quick note — we hit a blocker in the SDK integration that pushed our demo timeline out. The engineering team uncovered an incompatibility with the SDK's connection handshake; attached is a short error dump that shows the failure pattern (integration-error-log.txt).

Because of this, our internal demo for stakeholders is slipping from Oct 7 to Oct 14. Can Redwood extend our sandbox trial by two weeks and add a bit of sandbox tokens so our engineers can iterate while we get the patch in? If helpful, I can share a proposed mutual action plan.

We love the platform and don’t want this technical hiccup to derail momentum. Appreciate any runway you can provide.

Thanks,
Alyssa Torres
Head of Integrations, Integral Labs
Attachment: integration-error-log.txt (text)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Torres <alyssa@integral-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension & credits due to integration delay

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the logs. Sorry you hit this.

High-level plan:
- I’ll loop in engineering and CS to assess the fix timeline.
- On the commercial side I can provision an initial 2-week trial extension and a sandbox token top-up pending manager approval.

I’m attaching a mutual action plan template so we can track tasks and owners (mutual-action-plan.xlsx). Question for your team: are engineers blocked on us (SDK patch) or on a config change? If it’s our patch, we’ll prioritize.

Will be back shortly with ETA and the exact credit amount.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: short trial extension & credits due to integration delay

Forwarding Alyssa's note — they reported an SDK handshake error and need a demo window pushed to Oct 14. Can you weigh in: scope of the fix, estimated days, and whether we need to ship a patch or config tweak? If we ship a patch, we'll likely ask for a short validation window and some sandbox tokens for their QA.

Connor — can you take the lead on triage? If this is a quick patch we should aim to have a patch candidate within 48–72 hours.

Thanks,
Jordan

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Alyssa Torres <alyssa@integral-labs.com>
Date: 2027-10-03 09:12
Subject: Request: short trial extension & credits due to integration delay
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

[see above]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-04T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short trial extension & credits due to integration delay

I dug into the logs Alyssa sent. Root cause: our SDK's connection re-try logic fails when a client uses a TLS resumption pattern uncommon in their environment — reproduces consistently. I’ve prepared a minimal patch that updates the handshake timeout and retry backoff; I can push a candidate to a test branch today.

Estimate to get a validated patch into their sandbox: 3 business days (including QA). Ask: can we provision an extra 150k tokens to their sandbox for validation cycles + a 2-week trial extension so they have runway while we validate?

Attachment: sdk-patch.diff (text)

Connor O'Brien
Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Torres <alyssa@integral-labs.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-06T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension & credits due to integration delay

Hi Alyssa — appreciate the details and Connor’s quick triage.

We can approve the following as a one-time courtesy to keep the pilot moving:
- Trial extension: +14 days, new expiry Oct 28
- Sandbox token top-up: 150,000 tokens

Conditions:
- Connor's patch candidate is deployed to their sandbox within 3 business days and Alyssa confirms validation progress in the mutual action plan.
- We’ll log this concession on the HubSpot deal (link below) so it’s visible to all stakeholders.

Jordan/SN — please update the deal and confirm when the tokens are provisioned. Alyssa — once you confirm acceptance I’ll mark this as approved in the CRM.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Related HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/INT-4521
From: Alyssa Torres <alyssa@integral-labs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@integral-labs.com>
Date: 2027-10-06T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension & credits due to integration delay

Marissa — thank you, we accept.

We’ll track the mutual action plan and confirm validation milestones as Connor rolls out the patch. I’ll also share availability for the rescheduled demo window (Oct 14–15). Appreciate the quick turn and support — this keeps our exec sponsors aligned.

Regards,
Alyssa
Head of Integrations, Integral Labs
